name: nodecode
description: Node-based code view with agent-enforced locks: edit your codebase as a graph, lock modules the AI can't touch

commands.title: NodeCode: /init — Scan workspace and generate metadata

nodecode.autoLayout.description: Use dagre auto-layout for the graph.

nodecode.checkCommand.description: Read-only check command run after agent edits (e.g. 'npx tsc --noEmit'). Empty disables the indirect breakage guard.

nodecode.reviewEdits.description: Require diff review before agent edits apply. Default: auto-apply (edits are still logged and undoable).

nodecode.maxVisibleNodes.description: Cap visible nodes in the webview; extra nodes collapse into layer groups.

nodecode.modelProvider.description: Model behind the NodeCode agent. 'mock' runs fully offline with deterministic scripted answers.

nodecode.initBudgetTokens.description: Hard cap (estimated tokens) for a /init scan.

chatParticipants.name: nodecode
chatParticipants.description: Scan the workspace (/init) and ask about your code graph. Secret: locked nodes expose contracts only.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Scan the workspace bottom-up and generate node metadata + default locks
